items.markdown:
Your business is likely missing from Google because `your profile is unverified, suspended, or newly created` . Manage and check your account status directly via the [Google Business Profile Manager](https://business.google.com/).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXNfFWsuBdjK2qK5pDEp49gd_RM6OKrdjCGdRsN1bzOPdAgKB5H-euKJAImw5FWxGkJLDN_DLwYljOYtzE90DQv4tn8SDjak33JHWqWveOt_93JIjaEaib2aYTHEpp0BMgKN-b5X3uh5c)[[2]](https://support.google.com/business/thread/382646220/business-profile-no-longer-appearing-on-google-search?hl=en)

### Common Reasons Your Business Isn't Showing

- **Unverified Profile:** Google will not display a business in public search or maps results until you complete the verification process (via video, phone, or postcard).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1yXPOr-Wb5It90Pi8Q3XogqING1LSdjZ1aMQPk_G6oiYOKSrKbuOmebbkj7m4Zo_6tb-GBWDOiV8pHdPbJS7YobHxtCl1GTNrr3WAYxFaAh9vedKOVQfM9WXhnNybpeUErNLTcuCHYuAB6z3iHcjpwBDhe6eyulIMCOu7GgKxg)
- **Suspended or Flagged Listing:** Your profile may be suspended if the business name stuffs extra keywords (e.g., *"Joe's Plumbing - Best Cheap Plumber"* ), uses a P.O. Box instead of a physical address, or breaks Google guidelines.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1yXPOr-Wb5It90Pi8Q3XogqING1LSdjZ1aMQPk_G6oiYOKSrKbuOmebbkj7m4Zo_6tb-GBWDOiV8pHdPbJS7YobHxtCl1GTNrr3WAYxFaAh9vedKOVQfM9WXhnNybpeUErNLTcuCHYuAB6z3iHcjpwBDhe6eyulIMCOu7GgKxg)
- **New Listing or Recent Edits:** Brand-new profiles can take up to a month to rank, and minor profile edits can take up to 3 days to re-index and update.[[1]](https://support.google.com/business/answer/145585?hl=en)[[2]](https://support.google.com/business/thread/382646220/business-profile-no-longer-appearing-on-google-search?hl=en)
- **Wrong Primary Category:** Choosing an inaccurate category prevents Google from matching your business to relevant local searches.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1yXPOr-Wb5It90Pi8Q3XogqING1LSdjZ1aMQPk_G6oiYOKSrKbuOmebbkj7m4Zo_6tb-GBWDOiV8pHdPbJS7YobHxtCl1GTNrr3WAYxFaAh9vedKOVQfM9WXhnNybpeUErNLTcuCHYuAB6z3iHcjpwBDhe6eyulIMCOu7GgKxg)
- **Inconsistent NAP Data:** Discrepancies between your business Name, Address, and Phone number on Google versus your website or social media confuse the algorithm.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXW1bFqrPsDe1cEDO7OMK2TaoBU-3jnsuv_TMmjDUxAktVs-mhPsr0h3xMMcWVFm9Ix5_UdSbf6uHHPJ5_z0WvjLKvBGdHhfXTGb1fBtRsFMkTydUczJGMlUP1B0_AS_Fvzl42wTZkMz6GATJKRiGlaXsisTlWiDw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXPcdBvmmXLWzymaSkYm-F42lN20pJCfp34oq9AG1amWhyI1xvSqHz7ljKxPTAuMR29h4XEo-DkLIlC3PW4BDLnyRWBTfWymGPlNFRU3LkAl-hpzWLHz4Eo-3IPVJ4BWEEuTPRFyGo4SvV7gpQQYVI6B52umU0)
- **Intent Misinterpretation:** Users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpgEBxCJF13gG-457P3TC49wFBGmsJ8O0cyqAe1Z01TfO4OT1GvuYRdnw_YuKMA4Mcc0poB6r0DHXRgY4ZCut39rEehLz3l2LmPdghVmc4rfm2QqVfWl6Y9b3jzBTm08qJKJOXS6U9-4xARb2TBnfdl6ufcPOoaCZneLkcJ132yZlbFchVsOhQiySgHJeYAlBOgK-xGTC62CxRqT1akOxCwq_dF9gm_ab) agree that if your business name resembles a common general search term, Google may push it down unless you have strong online prominence.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpgEBxCJF13gG-457P3TC49wFBGmsJ8O0cyqAe1Z01TfO4OT1GvuYRdnw_YuKMA4Mcc0poB6r0DHXRgY4ZCut39rEehLz3l2LmPdghVmc4rfm2QqVfWl6Y9b3jzBTm08qJKJOXS6U9-4xARb2TBnfdl6ufcPOoaCZneLkcJ132yZlbFchVsOhQiySgHJeYAlBOgK-xGTC62CxRqT1akOxCwq_dF9gm_ab)

### How to Fix It

1. **Log in and Check Alerts:** Open the [Google Business Profile Manager](https://business.google.com/) to see if Google has flagged, suspended, or requested re-verification for your page.
2. **Complete Verification:** Follow the on-screen prompts to finish phone, video, or postcard verification if your status is pending.
3. **Clean Up Your Info:** Ensure your business name uses your real-world branding without keyword spam, select a tight primary category, and make sure your address and hours are up to date.
4. **Avoid Constant Edits:** Limit making frequent changes to your profile while Google is actively indexing your data.[[1]](https://support.google.com/business/thread/382646220/business-profile-no-longer-appearing-on-google-search?hl=en)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXNfFWsuBdjK2qK5pDEp49gd_RM6OKrdjCGdRsN1bzOPdAgKB5H-euKJAImw5FWxGkJLDN_DLwYljOYtzE90DQv4tn8SDjak33JHWqWveOt_93JIjaEaib2aYTHEpp0BMgKN-b5X3uh5c)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF15b_N2JxI2xj6eqxeuoz3lc5hN9t6I7yvZ1_aU9EIbi2xUBR_o9CdhqPkWv62G-lBgumlWGsV4U7dl5LspBnluwsa_cQdL9HYfNsLWAE3bvuDq-55ezGCQL9jKxGv6DlFaMtl_C_X_p3l4lp8I57wge-lSvNwZjq3MyWLaTgH0IODQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1yXPOr-Wb5It90Pi8Q3XogqING1LSdjZ1aMQPk_G6oiYOKSrKbuOmebbkj7m4Zo_6tb-GBWDOiV8pHdPbJS7YobHxtCl1GTNrr3WAYxFaAh9vedKOVQfM9WXhnNybpeUErNLTcuCHYuAB6z3iHcjpwBDhe6eyulIMCOu7GgKxg)

If you'd like, tell me:

- **Is your profile marked as verified** in your dashboard?
- **Is it a physical storefront** or a service-area business?

I can help you troubleshoot the next steps to get it listed.
